mapper.select: select id,collect_time,app_id,instance_id,command,calls,usec from instance_command_latency_minute where app_id = #{appId} and collect_time between #{beginTime} and #{endTime} order by instance_id, command, collect_time

select id,collect_time,app_id,instance_id,command,calls,usec,max_avg_usec from instance_command_latency_hour where app_id = #{appId} and collect_time between #{beginTime} and #{endTime} order by instance_id, command, collect_time
mapper.delete: delete from instance_command_latency_minute where collect_time < #{collectTime} limit 5000
delete from instance_command_latency_hour where collect_time < #{collectTime} limit 5000
